content: Root cause: The bug was caused by the incorrect handling of command-line arguments in the Distcp action, specifically when using the `-D` option to set configuration properties. The original implementation did not properly process these options, leading to failures when they were included in the arguments. The patch fixed this by using `ToolRunner.run()` instead of directly calling `distcp.run(args)`, which correctly handles the command-line options and allows for the expected behavior when setting configurations via the `-D` option.
